text: International Economics and Trade is an interdisciplinary subject that focuses on global resource allocation, cross-border trade rules and cross-border business operations, integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as economics, international trade practice, international commercial law, foreign languages and information technology. This major, against the backdrop of "globalization", studies the flow patterns of goods, services and capital among countries, and aims to cultivate compound talents with an international perspective, cross-cultural communication skills and practical operation skills. It is dedicated to solving practical problems such as international trade frictions, cross-border supply chain management and international market expansion.
